listing.description: Studio with a private pool on the 15th floor of Samana Lake Views, Dubai Production City (IMPZ): 416 sq ft. units.notes: Direct sellers (redacted copies of the Oqood and of the developer's statement received 12 Nov 2026, for a first assessment: see the originals before Form A). Studio + Pool per Samana's statement; 15th floor going by the unit number (confirm it on the SPA); net area 38.69 sq m (416 sq ft) per the Oqood; original price AED 673,596 on the Oqood (a copy printed 1 Nov 2024, not mortgaged then: get a current one). Jointly owned: every owner on the Oqood signs Form A and the MOU. Samana's customer statement of 20 Oct 2026: property price AED 673,596; received AED 290,478.30 (the receipts less AED 6,800 moved to the owners' other unit in August 2025), of which AED 259,334.46 against the price (38.5%), with the Oqood fee (AED 26,943.84) and admin fee (AED 4,200) paid. No post-dated cheques held, no bounced cheques, discounts or refunds on the statement; the last receipts are of 3 Nov 2025. Instalments 1 to 16 paid (to 25 Oct 2025); 11 instalments unpaid, 25 Nov 2025 to 25 Sep 2026, one of them 6.5% (AED 43,783.74, 25 Dec 2025): overdue AED 111,143.34. Penalty AED 75,000 unpaid. Still to come on the statement: 16 x AED 6,735.96 (25 Oct 2026 to 25 Jan 2028; the 25 Oct 2026 one has fallen due since the statement) and 58 x AED 3,367.98 (25 Feb 2028 to 25 Nov 2032). 38.5% paid is under the 40% many developers want before a resale NOC; clearing the overdue instalments brings it to 55%. The penalty follows AED 1,500 per overdue instalment per month on the statement (the oldest ones stop at their early 2026 figure), so it keeps growing while nothing is paid, by about AED 15,000 at the next monthly charge after the statement and AED 16,500 at the one after. The first monthly charge after the statement fell between 25 Oct and 20 Nov 2026, most likely before 12 Nov: expect about AED 90,000 now (about 7% below the original price with the fees on the buyer). Get a fresh statement before the advert goes live and again before the MOU, and enter it in this file (plan rows, overdue, late fees, the check date). Plan rows are in whole dirhams and add up to the balance. Price: the owners want 20% below the original price, AED 538,876 in total = AED 124,614 to the owners + the AED 414,262 still owed to Samana; the late fees are outside that price and who bears them is not agreed yet: settle it with the owners before the advert goes live (with the late fees on the buyer the unit is about 9% below the original price, not 20%). Handover October 2027 per Samana's website; construction about 23% per DLD data (Nov 2026). Before the MOU, ask Samana for its resale NOC conditions and fee, and whether it has started a default or termination procedure for the unpaid instalments (a notice to the owners, a request to DLD). Photos: Samana's renders of the project, from its website.
